label: FCC-ee Z pole IDEA baseline
notes: Luminosity is the FCC-ee Z-pole target used in the project specification.
l_min_m and l_max_m are analysis inputs, not parsed from Delphes.
eta_max=3.0, photon_energy_min_GeV=0.5, and photon_efficiency=0.99 are taken from the IDEA Delphes card.
delta_theta_res_deg=1.5 is the current conservative calorimeter-cell scale from the IDEA phi segmentation, pi/120.
Production contours require background inputs. The 3-event criterion is only a floor.
Binned limits use M_gg bins for resolved_prompt and recoil-photon-energy bins for invisible.
The invisible recoil-energy histogram extends above sqrt(s)/2 to retain detector/ISR-smeared endpoint signal.
The official contour multiplies the analytic flat-efficiency yield by branch-aware Delphes-derived detector_correction_factor values from the full-analysis efficiency map.
